recommended.title: Recommendation boundary
recommended.acceptance: The deliverable is a package and information boundary, not a recommender: eligibility is resolved upstream so recommendation can never make content playable, candidate generation may see only the active profile's explicit watchlist, that profile's progress and completion state, catalog metadata and already-resolved eligibility, and it returns content ids plus generator reasons so the reason trail survives the layer most likely to lose it

recommended.title: Optional API-driven autonomous dispatcher
recommended.acceptance: Optional external agent runner can dispatch queued tasks to configured providers with budgets, audit logs, retries, and human approval gates
